items.reply: I change my classification to TP/nit. The added getCredentials() recreates the complete code list, and isValid() never consumes accepted codes, so the state limitation is real. However, this provider is a testsuite fixture, and testRecoveryKeysSetupAndLogin exercises only setup and the first recovery-code login, which this implementation supports. The reported limitation neither affects production users nor invalidates that test’s assertions.
